question: A and B can do a piece of work in 20 days and 25 days, respectively. They work on alternate days,starting with A till the work gets completed. How long (in days) would it take A and B to complete the work?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A can do a piece of work in 20 days

B can do a piece of work in 25 days 

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work/No. of days

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume total work be ( L.C.M of 20,25) be100 unit 

( you can assume any number but for the sake of calculation it is advised to take L.C.M. of the given numbers)

Efficiency of A = work done by A in 1 day = 100/20 = 5 </p
